actions.script: def session=ec.entity.find('zenith.erp.pos.PosSession').condition('sessionId',closedSession.sessionId).forUpdate(true).one() session.setAll([statusId:'PsClosed',closeDate:closedSession.closeDate,lastActivityDate:closedSession.lastActivityDate]); session.update() def cash=ec.service.sync().name('zenith.pos.PosServices.get#PosSessionCashSummary').parameter('sessionId',session.sessionId).call() if (ec.message.hasError()) return session.expectedCash=cash.expectedCash session.cashDifference=((session.closingCash ?: 0) as BigDecimal) - (cash.expectedCash as BigDecimal) session.update()
